title: claude-session config
description: Maps are deep-merged across config.yaml and config.d/*.yaml; lists are replaced, except hooks.* lists, which append. Environment overrides (CSESSION_<KEY>) apply only to these top-level scalar keys: claude_bin, default_kind, min_claude_version, summary_max_bytes, artifact_max_bytes, input_max_bytes, notes_context_timeout, notes_context_max_bytes, retention_days, lost_grace, auto_exit_delay, kill_grace, poll_interval, session_start_timeout (durations accept bare numbers of seconds).

claude_bin.description: Non-empty, no control characters (C0, DEL or C1).

min_claude_version.description: Minimum Claude Code version (claude --version) a launch accepts; older fails the launch with end_reason claude_too_old. Built-in: the version the spike verified.

default_kind.description: Kind used when --kind is omitted; must match the kind-name grammar and name a built-in or configured kind.

permission_profile.description: Name of a permission profile from config.

implicit_done.description: Whether a clean headless exit without a report counts as done (report.implicit). false: exited-unreported with end_reason no_report. Built-in: false for gate-check and rank, true otherwise.

allow.description: Names (^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$) or PREFIX* globs (a valid name start followed by one trailing *; anything else is an invalid config). Only a kind's config env.allow naming a secret_env variable exactly passes it; per-call --env-allow cannot, and --env-allowlist-only replaces env.allow, so it unlocks nothing then.

set.description: Literal values, not treated as secrets (never put a credential here). Names match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$; no CSESSION_* name may be set. Values contain no NUL; ${CSESSION_DIR}, ${CWD}, ${HOME} and ${GIT_DIR} are expanded once and any other '${' is an invalid config ('$' and '}' alone are literal). On third-party-reading runs the token removals and GH_CONFIG_DIR/GLAB_CONFIG_DIR win over env.set.

path_prepend.description: Absolute directories (no ':' or NUL), prepended to PATH as written (not expanded).

timeout.description: Seconds as a positive number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); zero is refused; at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not). A text value so small that it underflows to zero (e.g. '0.' then hundreds of zeros then '1s') matches the pattern but is refused by the loader. null or 'none': no bound.

interactive_timeout.description: Seconds as a positive number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); zero is refused; at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not). A text value so small that it underflows to zero (e.g. '0.' then hundreds of zeros then '1s') matches the pattern but is refused by the loader. null or 'none': no bound.

model.description: When set: non-empty, no control characters (C0, DEL or C1), and not starting with '-' (it is passed as claude --model <value>).

claude_args.description: Config files and drop-ins only; never from environment overrides or flags. Isolated runs accept only --verbose and --debug; anything else fails the launch (unsafe_claude_args). Trusted runs: anything.

kinds.description: Deep-merged over the built-in kinds (lists replace). A new kind starts from the built-in review kind's fields. Names: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$.

permissions.description: Claude Code permissions settings (allow, deny, ask, defaultMode, ...). additionalDirectories is refused for isolated runs, and defaultMode is ignored there (isolated runs always get dontAsk). Trusted runs: a profile defaultMode is used; without one the generated settings set default when setting_sources excludes user.

sandbox.description: Claude Code sandbox settings (network, filesystem). enabled, failIfUnavailable, allowUnsandboxedCommands, excludedCommands and autoAllowBashIfSandboxed: true are refused for third-party-reading or sandboxed runs (the generated autoAllowBashIfSandboxed is false); generated isolation keys always override profile content.

claude_auth_env.description: Variable names (^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$; exact names, no globs) added to the built-in list (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_MODEL, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX; AWS_* only when CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK is set to a true value; GOOGLE_*, CLOUD_ML_REGION, ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID only when CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX is; a flag is true when its passed value, trimmed and lowercased, is 1, true, yes or on).

secret_env.description: Variable names (^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$; exact names, no globs) stripped from every kind unless the kind's config env.allow names them exactly (not with --env-allow, and not while --env-allowlist-only is in effect).

notes_context_timeout.description: Seconds as a positive number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); zero is refused; at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not). A text value so small that it underflows to zero (e.g. '0.' then hundreds of zeros then '1s') matches the pattern but is refused by the loader.

input_max_bytes.description: Cap for each --prompt-file and --input-file (bytes); larger exits 2.

lost_grace.description: Seconds as a positive number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); zero is refused; at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not). A text value so small that it underflows to zero (e.g. '0.' then hundreds of zeros then '1s') matches the pattern but is refused by the loader.

auto_exit_delay.description: Seconds as a non-negative number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not).

kill_grace.description: Seconds as a non-negative number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not).

poll_interval.description: Seconds as a positive number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); zero is refused; at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not). A text value so small that it underflows to zero (e.g. '0.' then hundreds of zeros then '1s') matches the pattern but is refused by the loader.

session_start_timeout.description: Seconds as a positive number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); zero is refused; at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not). A text value so small that it underflows to zero (e.g. '0.' then hundreds of zeros then '1s') matches the pattern but is refused by the loader. Headless runs: when no SessionStart arrives within it, exec logs a warning and adds it to warnings (injected hooks may be suppressed by disableAllHooks or managed-only hooks).

timeout.description: Seconds as a positive number (fractions allowed), or a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '90s', '10m', '0.5s'); zero is refused; at most 36500d (the text form too: the loader enforces the maximum, the string pattern does not). A text value so small that it underflows to zero (e.g. '0.' then hundreds of zeros then '1s') matches the pattern but is refused by the loader. Default 30s. On timeout the hook's process group gets SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after kill_grace. Gate hooks need an explicit longer timeout.
